topic: Asking for a Box for the Leftovers

script.title: LEFTOVERS TO GO
script.scene_zh: 美式餐館 · 打包剩菜
script.story_hook: The pie is half gone, but the night is young.
script.intro_zh: 派吃了一半，夜色還長，剩菜也要好好帶回家。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to tonight's diner scene. Listen for handy take-home phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今晚的小餐館場景。留意打包剩菜時會用到的說法。
script.outro: That's how you send a good meal home safe. Play it again, echo every line.
script.outro_zh: 一頓好餐就這樣安心帶回家。再撥一次，逐句大聲跟讀。
script.practice_intro_en: Now, take each line and say it aloud.
script.practice_intro_zh: 接下來，我們一句一句大聲跟讀。
script.title_quote: This crust is calling my name
script.char_a_description: a man in his early thirties with short auburn hair swept to one side, wearing a faded blue flannel shirt open over a white tee, khaki trousers, and a medium build
script.char_b_description: a woman in her forties with grey streaked hair in a low ponytail, thin wire glasses, a coral pink server shirt under a denim apron, and a sturdy build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Evening! Is this chair still mine?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivnɪŋ ɪz ðɪs ˈtʃɛɹ stɪl maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 晚上好！這個位子還是我的吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, it's yours until close.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɪts ˈjʊɹz ʌnˈtɪl kloʊs/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，關門之前都算你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, because this pie is amazing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt bɪˈkəz ðɪs ˈpaɪ ɪz əˈmeɪzɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，因為這派真的太好吃了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Glad you like it, you left half.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlæd ju ˈlaɪk ɪt ju lɛft hæf/
dialogue.zh: 你喜歡就好，不過你還剩一半呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The half portion was already a big help.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hæf ˈpoɹʃən wəz ˈɔlɹɛdi ə ˈbɪɡ hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 半份的量其實就已經很實在。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our pies are huge, no judgment here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊɚ ˈpaɪz ɑɹ hjuːdʒ noʊ ˈdʒʌdʒmənt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我們的派個頭都很大，這不怪你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, this crust is calling my name.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðɪs ˈkrʌst ɪz ˈkɔlɪŋ maɪ ˈneɪm/
dialogue.zh: 唉，這層酥皮一直在呼喚我耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, want a box for that?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɑnt ə ˈbɑks fɔɹ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 好，要幫你裝一盒帶走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please, and a fork to go too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz ænd ə fɔɹk tu ˈɡoʊ tu/
dialogue.zh: 好，請再給我一支可以帶走的叉子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper or plastic? Both work fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpɚ ɔɹ ˈplæstɪk boʊθ wɝk faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 紙盒還是塑膠盒？兩種都沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, which one keeps the crust crisp?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm wɪtʃ wʌn kipz ðə ˈkrʌst krɪsp/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，哪一種比較能讓酥皮保持脆？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper, it breathes, the steam gets out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpɚ ɪt bɹiðz ðə stim ɡɛts aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 紙盒會透氣，熱氣不會悶在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then paper, please, I like crunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈpeɪpɚ pliz aɪ laɪk krʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 那我選紙盒，我愛脆脆的口感。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, how about the gravy?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn haʊ əˈbaʊt ðə ˈɡɹeɪvi/
dialogue.zh: 好，那醬汁怎麼處理？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, can the gravy ride separate?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm kən ðə ˈɡɹeɪvi ɹaɪdz ˈsɛpɚət/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，醬汁可以分開裝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It can, tiny cup, lid snaps tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kæn ˈtaɪni kʌp lɪd snæps taɪt/
dialogue.zh: 可以，用一個小杯子裝，蓋子會扣得很緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart, the mash gets soft otherwise.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ðə mæʃ ɡɛts sɔft ˈɔðɚˌwaɪz/
dialogue.zh: 聰明，不然馬鈴薯泥會變軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, soggy is not a style.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ˈsɑɡi ɪz nɑt ə staɪl/
dialogue.zh: 就是這個道理，軟爛可不是一種風格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Haha, and the cornbread, still good?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑhɑ ænd ðə ˈkɔɹnˌbrɛd stɪl ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，那玉米麵包還適合帶走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two pieces left, they travel well.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈpiˌsɛs lɛft ðeɪ ˈtɹævəl wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 還剩兩塊，很耐放，帶走沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll grab them, did the kitchen hear me?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ɡɹæb ðəm dɪd ðə ˈkɪtʃən hɪɹ mi/
dialogue.zh: 那我帶走，廚師聽見我剛說的話了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She did, she's adding one free piece.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi dɪd ʃiz ˈædɪŋ wʌn fɹi pis/
dialogue.zh: 聽見了，她還多送你一塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, tell her I said superstar.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ tɛl ɚ ˈaɪ sɛd ˈsuːpɚˌstɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，請轉告她，她是超級巨星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will, box number two for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl bɑks ˈnʌmbɚ tu fɔɹ ju/
dialogue.zh: 我會的，這是你的第二個盒子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I reheat all this at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ ˌɹiˈhit ɔl ðɪs æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 回家後這一大袋要怎麼重新加熱？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oven, ten minutes, medium heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌvən tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ˈmidɪəm hit/
dialogue.zh: 放烤箱，中火十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the microwave, um, is that okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈmeɪkɹəˌweɪv ʌm ɪz ðæt oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那微波爐呢，嗯，可以用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It works, though the crust goes soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɝks ðoʊ ðə ˈkrʌst ɡoʊz sɔft/
dialogue.zh: 也可以，只是酥皮會變軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soft is a sad word for crust.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft ɪz ə sæd wɝd fɔɹ ˈkrʌst/
dialogue.zh: 對酥皮來說，「軟」是個悲傷的字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use a skillet, it wakes the crust up.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ə ˈskɪlət ɪt weɪks ðə ˈkrʌst ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 用平底鍋吧，能把酥皮喚醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold, you think of everything here.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɑld ju θɪŋk ʌv ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 成交，你們這裡什麼都想到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Years of feeding hungry humans.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɪɹz ʌv ˈfidɪŋ ˈhʌŋɡɹi ˈjumənz/
dialogue.zh: 畢竟喂飽飢腸轆轆的人很多年了吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do these boxes cost anything extra?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðiz ˈbɑksɪz kɑst ˈɛnɪθɪŋ ˈɛkstɹə/
dialogue.zh: 這些打包盒要額外收費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One fifty for two, it's on the bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈfɔɹti fɔɹ tu ɪts ɑn ðə bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 兩個一共一塊五，會列進帳單裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair, and could I get a receipt?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ ænd kʊd aɪ ɡɛt ə ɹɪˈsit/
dialogue.zh: 合理，可以再給我一張收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper or email, your call.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpɚ ɔɹ ˈimeɪl jɔɹ kɔl/
dialogue.zh: 紙本或電子郵件，由你決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Email, my printer hates ink cartridges.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈimeɪl maɪ ˈpɹɪntɚ ˈheɪts ɪŋk ˈkɑɹdʒəz/
dialogue.zh: 傳電子郵件吧，我的印表機很討厭墨水匣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, it only works on Sundays.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ tu ɪt ˈoʊnli wɝks ɑn ˈsʌndeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我的也是，它只有週日願意上班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, same. Can I have a cup of water?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ seɪm kən aɪ hæv ə kʌp ʌv ˈwɔɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我家那台也是。可以再給我一杯水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the house, filling a to-go cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə haʊz ˈfɪlɪŋ ə tu ˈɡoʊ kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 這杯請客，我幫你裝一杯帶走的水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a legend, does the lid fit?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹz ə ˈlɛdʒənd dʌz ðə lɪd fɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你真是個傳奇，杯蓋蓋得上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, we'll double it, no drips.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst wil ˈdʌbəl ɪt noʊ dɹɪps/
dialogue.zh: 差不多，我們蓋兩個，就不會滴了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Teamwork, I also want two napkins.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtimˌwɝk aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ wɑnt tu ˈnæpkɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 團隊合作真好。我再要兩張餐巾紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four, because napkins deserve pairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ bɪˈkəz ˈnæpkɪnz dɪˈzɝv pɛɹz/
dialogue.zh: 給你四張，餐巾紙向來成雙成對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, the roll basket, can I take one?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðə ɹoʊl ˈbæskɪt kən aɪ teɪk wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 等等，那一籃麵包，我可以拿一顆走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take two, they freeze like champs.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk tu ðeɪ ˈfriz laɪk tʃæmpz/
dialogue.zh: 帶兩顆吧，它們冷凍後依舊很棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like champs, I'll write that down.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk tʃæmpz aɪl ɹaɪt ðæt daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 「依舊很棒」，我要把這句記下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it when your toast behaves badly.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ɪt wɛn jɔɹ toʊst bɪˈheɪvz ˈbædli/
dialogue.zh: 等你的吐司不聽話時就說這句。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, okay, total with the boxes?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ oʊˈkeɪ ˈtoʊtəl wɪð ðə ˈbɑksɪz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，好，連盒子在內總共多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight twenty-five, tap whenever ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ˈtwɛnti faɪv tæp wɛnˈɛvɚ ˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 八塊二毛五，準備好就感應付款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, um, did my receipt send?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ʌm dɪd maɪ ɹɪˈsit sɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 搞定。嗯，收據傳出去了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sent, check spam, it hides there.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnt tʃɛk spæm ɪt haɪdz ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 傳了，查一下垃圾信，收據愛躲在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, you're good at this job.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt jʊɹz ɡʊd æt ðɪs dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 找到了，你真適合做這行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One secret: boxes beat waste every day.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈsɪkɹət ˈbɑksɪz bit weɪst ˈɛvɹi deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 秘訣就一個：打包永遠勝過浪費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wisdom in a denim apron, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪzdəm ɪn ə ˈdɛnɪm əˈpɹɑn θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 牛仔圍裙裡藏著智慧，真是謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, the bag is yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm ðə bæɡ ɪz ˈjʊɹz/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，這袋外帶就交給你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last thing, the lid keeps slipping.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst θɪŋ ðə lɪd kipz ˈslɪpɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 最後一件事，餐盒蓋一直滑開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuck the napkin under, it holds tight now.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʌk ðə ˈnæpkɪn ˈʌndɚ ɪt hoʊldz taɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 把餐巾紙塞在蓋子下面壓著，這樣就穩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Genius, see you next Tuesday, maybe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒinjəs si ju nɛkst ˈtʊzdeɪ ˈmeɪbi/
dialogue.zh: 太厲害了，下週二再見，應該會來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We save pies, you save that appetite. Bye!
dialogue.phonetic: /wi seɪv ˈpaɪz ju seɪv ðæt ˈæpɪˌtaɪt baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我們替你留派，你也要好好保留你的好胃口。再見！

script.youtube_title: 【打包剩菜🥡】「這層酥皮在呼喚我」💬學用英文要打包盒🥧｜聽完就敢開口｜60句沉浸式A2英文聽力｜Leftovers To Go
script.youtube_title_en: "This Crust Is Calling My Name" — Boxing Up Diner Leftovers
script.youtube_description:
「這層酥皮在呼喚我」——在美式餐館吃到一半，怎麼請服務生幫你打包剩菜？本集是 60 句沉浸式英文聽力練習，場景就在關門前的小餐館。

你會聽到：要保鮮盒與紙盒的說法、醬汁分開裝、蓋子不聽話的應變、回爐加熱的叮嚀，還有打包費與外帶水的實用句子。整段對話只用 A2 初級單字，加上美國人每天的真實口吻：um、well、hmm、oh、ha。

聽完你就會用：Want a box for that、to go、the gravy ride separate、did my receipt send。後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱，開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"This crust is calling my name" — you're full, the pie is half gone, and you still want it home in one piece. This 60-line immersive listening practice happens at a US diner right before close.

You will hear: asking for a box, paper or plastic, keeping gravy separate, the lid that will not sit still, reheating advice, the small packing fee, and a to-go cup of water.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the small talk Americans actually use: um, well, hmm, oh, ha. By the end you'll own phrases like Want a box for that, to go, and How do I reheat all this at home.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🥡餐廳打包剩菜英文｜要盒・醬汁分開・加熱叮嚀｜蓋子不聽話怎麼辦｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
派吃到一半，肚子已經飽了，酥皮卻還在跟你招手，該怎麼請服務生幫你打包？醬汁要分開裝還是澆在上頭？盒子會不會另外收費？

這一集帶大家走進關門前的小餐館，從要一個打包盒、挑紙盒或塑膠盒、醬汁獨立打包，一路聊到加熱方式、袋蓋糾紛與外帶水，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🥡 要盒句子：So, want a box for that?
🍲 分開裝醬：Um, can the gravy ride separate?
🔥 加熱叮嚀：Oven, ten minutes, medium heat.
🥤 外帶水：On the house, filling a to-go cup.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、hmm 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用啃文法，多聽就會用。跟著這頓晚飯走完一趟，下次打包時，話自然從嘴邊冒出來。

祝你每次都吃得開心、帶得安心。
script.thumbnail_expression: eyeing the last pie slice with a grin
script.thumbnail_action: holding up a to-go box with a fork tucked inside
